author: visegrad24
text:
Ayodele Jamgbadi, 30, an African man, is accused of killing 61-year-old Elizabeth Line worker Jorge Ortega with a single punch after becoming angry because he missed his train in east London.

Prosecutors say Jamgbadi began kicking an advertising frame before Ortega, who had worked on the railway for 24 years, and two colleagues came out to calm him down. Jamgbadi turned around and punched Ortega in the face with “significant force,” causing him to fall backwards and smash his head against the platform. Ortega suffered a severe traumatic brain injury and died two days later.

After his arrest, Jamgbadi told police: “I punched him in the face. I literally punched him in the face,” before asking: “What are you going to do about it, are you going to nick me?”
Jamgbadi has been deemed mentally unfit to plead and is being held in a psychiatric hospital.

Ortega had worked on the railway for 24 years and was a customer experience assistant for MTREL, which operates the Elizabeth Line. His family described him as “the kindest soul,” a devoted husband, father and grandfather who loved cooking, drawing and art.
